subject: Money
title: Flat Tax Debate
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Flat Tax Debate.

hook.text: Estonia introduced a flat 26% income tax in 1994. No brackets, no deductions. Simple.

buildup.text: A flat tax charges every taxpayer the same rate. Supporters say it's fair, simple, and hard to game.

discovery.text: Eastern European countries adopted flat taxes in the 2000s. Several saw economic growth and better compliance.

twist.text: A flat rate isn't actually flat in impact. Twenty percent of $30,000 hurts more than 20% of $3 million.

climax.text: Simplicity versus fairness. Every tax system trades one for the other. No system achieves both.

quiz.question: What is a flat tax?
options: A tax that decreases with income
A single rate applied to all income levels
